name: Push-Up (Standard)
instructions: Start in a straight-line plank, hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the chest to just above the floor, elbows ~45 degrees to the torso.
Press up to full lockout without flaring the hips.
Keep the core braced throughout; count only completed, full-range reps (spec §4 C1).

name: Front Plank (Standard)
instructions: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Squeeze glutes and brace the core; do not let the hips sag or pike.
Hold the position for the prescribed duration.
A partial hold (hips visibly dropped) does not count toward the target (spec §4 C1).
